async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Navigate to the project details page for 'Byte Blaze / awesome_web_agents'
    await navigate_to_project_details(page, 'Byte Blaze / awesome_web_agents')
    
    # Step 2: Wait for the page to load after navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Step 3: Click on the 'Issues' link to go to the issues page
    # Assuming the issues link is accessible via a role; common in GitLab: link with name 'Issues' or similar
    # Use get_by_role with name containing 'Issues' to find it
    issues_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Issues', exact=False)
    await issues_link.click()
    
    # Step 4: Wait for the issues page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Step 5: Click the button to create a new issue
    # Common button: 'New issue' or similar
    new_issue_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='New issue', exact=False)
    await new_issue_button.click()
    
    # Step 6: Wait for the new issue form to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Step 7: Fill in the issue title
    title_field = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Title')
    await title_field.fill('Plan to support Webagent in huggingface dataset next quarter?')
    
    # Step 8: Fill in the issue description
    description_field = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Description')
    await description_field.fill('Do you have any plan on supporting Webagent in the next quarter in huggingface dataset?')
    
    # Step 9: Submit the issue
    submit_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Submit issue', exact=False)
    await submit_button.click()
    
    # Step 10: Wait for the issue to be created and confirm
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # No further actions needed; the issue is created
